PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 16, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-54853  Recommendation to approve April 2, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54854  Recommendation to approve Retirement Order Nos. 6196 and 6197 for inventory
  items that have become obsolete or unrepairable during the current year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

3.  26-54855  Recommendation to receive and file the 2026 Annual Ethics Update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54856  Recommendation to receive and file the Brown Act Training.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54861  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal UT-26-305 and award a contract
  to Well Home Construction for Water Intrusion Assessment and Mitigation
  Services, in the amount of $1,502,300, plus a 10% contingency of $150,230, for a
  total amount not to exceed $1,652,530 for a one-year period, with the option to
  extend the term for up to one additional year, at the discretion of the General
  Manager, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary
  to enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  THURSDAY, APRIL 16, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54862  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to support the Los Angeles
  County Water Plan (County Water Plan) to strategically align the Long Beach
  Utilities Department with the vision for water resilience in the County Water Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54863  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Public Utilities Department’s
  Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) for the period ended September
  30, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54867  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Public Utilities Department’s
  Fiscal Year 2026 Second Quarter Financial Review.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-54868  Recommendation to receive and file April 2, 2026 Communications Committee
  Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

CLOSED SESSION

26-54869  Existing Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to existing
  litigation pursuant to paragraph (1) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the
  California Government Code. Louis Andrawes, et al., v. City of Long Beach, et al., Los
  Angeles Superior Court Case No. 25STCV17881; Donald Frizzell, et al. v. City of Long
  Beach, et al., Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 25LBCV03096; Karine Greene, et
  al. v. City of Long Beach, et al., Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 26LBCV0506;
  and Frank Lopez, et al., v. City of Long Beach, et al., Los Angeles Superior Court
  Case No. 26LBCV0098.

26-54870  Threatened or Anticipated Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel
  relating to threatened or anticipated litigation pursuant to paragraph (2) of subdivision
